user.description: Step on the scale briefly, then pick it from the list. Detected Lefu scales are listed first and marked.

profile.title: First person
profile.description: Body fat, muscle mass and the other body values are estimated from the measured impedances together with sex, height and age. More people can be added later via “Configure”.

data_description.birthday: Recommended: the age is then always up to date.
data_description.age: Only used if no date of birth is given; it has to be adjusted manually every year.
data_description.reference_weight: Optional: helps to assign the first weighing to the right person automatically. After that the last measured weight counts.

abort.no_devices_found: No Bluetooth device found. Step on the scale and try again.

error.age_required: Please enter a date of birth or an age.

init.title: People and settings
init.description: Each person gets a device of their own with their own sensors. A weighing is assigned automatically to the person whose last weight is closest.

data_description.birthday: Recommended: the age is then always up to date.
data_description.age: Only used if no date of birth is given; it has to be adjusted manually every year.
data_description.reference_weight: Optional: helps to assign the first weighing to the right person automatically. After that the last measured weight counts.

data_description.age: Only used if no date of birth is given; it has to be adjusted manually every year.
data_description.reference_weight: Optional: helps to assign the first weighing to the right person automatically. After that the last measured weight counts.

remove_person.title: Remove person
remove_person.description: The person is removed together with their device and all their sensors. The history of those sensors is no longer accessible afterwards.

settings.title: Assignment and question
settings.description: A weighing is assigned automatically if the weight differs from a person's last weight by no more than the tolerance and no second person is similarly close. Otherwise Home Assistant asks.

data.untested_body: Calculate body values for an untested scale

data_description.notify: Devices of the Home Assistant app that get a notification with the matching people as buttons when a weighing is unclear. Without a selection the question only appears as a notification in Home Assistant.
data_description.untested_body: Only for scales that are not on the tested list. The calculation is calibrated for the tested models; on other scales the values may be wrong. Please compare them with the app.

error.age_required: Please enter a date of birth or an age.

untested_model.title: Scale “{model}” has not been tested

unsupported_four_electrode.title: Scale “{model}” uses a different protocol
unsupported_four_electrode.description:
“{model}” sends an impedance inside its weight packet. That is the format of another Lefu device family (usually scales with 4 electrodes), which this integration does not support. The weight is still shown; body values are not available.

Please create a test report with the diagnostics file attached: {url}

unsupported_unknown_advertising.title: Scale “{model}” uses an unknown protocol
unsupported_unknown_advertising.description:
The Bluetooth data of “{model}” does not contain the packets this integration understands, so no values can be shown. Nothing is guessed.

Please create a test report with the diagnostics file attached: {url}

unsupported_unknown_frames.title: Scale “{model}” uses an unknown protocol
unsupported_unknown_frames.description:
During a measurement “{model}” sent data this integration does not understand, and no impedances arrived. Body values are therefore not available; the weight is still shown.

Please create a test report with the diagnostics file attached: {url}

unsupported_no_notify.title: Scale “{model}” uses an unknown protocol
unsupported_no_notify.description:
“{model}” does not offer the Bluetooth channel (FFF4) this integration reads the body analysis from. Body values are therefore not available.

Please create a test report with the diagnostics file attached: {url}

no_impedance.title: No body analysis from “{model}”
no_impedance.description:
{count} measurements in a row arrived without impedances, so no body values could be calculated. Possible causes:

- measured with socks or shoes, or the handle was not held with both hands until the end
- the Unique Health app was connected to the scale at the same time
- the Bluetooth adapter or proxy is too far away or does not support active connections
- the scale has only 4 electrodes or uses another protocol

This notice disappears with the next complete measurement.
